target: Finite mean offer minus no-offer effect on binary withdrawal before transfer by month 12 for the original randomized baseline roster
assignment_law: Condition on fixed recorded totals in each college, with uniform allocations within colleges and independent allocation between colleges, as the analysis law used in Book 9.
assumptions: Correct known labels and a binary defined endpoint for every assigned person under each offer policy

interpretation.D6_COMPLETION: Realized, college-weighted statistic across unknown-label completions
interpretation.D6_INTERVAL: Conservative interval for the finite offer effect under the stated conditional law
interpretation.D6_TOY_MAX_P: Maximum exact sharp-null p value across two invented completions
